jobs.title: Director, Engineering
jobs.description:
About Veeco

You probably don’t realize it, but what we do at Veeco touches the lives of every person, every day. It’s a bold statement, but it’s true. From the smartphones in our pockets that access the world’s collective knowledge, to the cloud-based services where all that information lives, to high-speed wireless communication and computing power needed to drive artificial intelligence, augmented and virtual reality, gaming and so much more, our technology is all around us.

We design, develop, manufacture, and service highly complex, cutting-edge machines used by our customers to create the essential devices that drive the digital age, connect the world, and improve the human experience. Along with the world’s leading technology companies, many of which are household names, we help solve their most difficult material science challenges, enabling technologies for a more connected, sustainable, and convenient world.

We’re looking for material difference-makers to join our growing team. Interested? Learn more at www.veeco.com/careers .

Overview

Veeco's Advanced Deposition and Etch portfolio sits at the center of increasingly demanding semiconductor manufacturing requirements, where customers expect faster innovation cycles, higher equipment performance, and predictable factory execution. As Director of Engineering, you will lead the multi-disciplinary organization responsible for translating customer, technology, and business requirements into manufacturable products that meet performance, quality, cost, and schedule commitments. Your decisions will directly influence product roadmaps, development velocity, and customer adoption across Veeco's advanced process equipment portfolio. Working across Mechanical, Electrical, Systems, and Software Engineering, you will shape the next generation of deposition and etch platforms while building a high-performing engineering organization capable of scaling with the business.

Responsibilities

Lead engineering execution across the full product lifecycle, from requirements definition through customer deployment and field performance.
Direct multi-disciplinary Mechanical, Electrical, Systems, and Software Engineering teams to deliver advanced deposition and etch programs on committed schedule, cost, and quality targets.
Drive system architecture and technical decision-making that balance performance, manufacturability, reliability, serviceability, and risk.
Partner with Product Management, Operations, Supply Chain, Technology, and Customer Support leaders to translate market requirements into successful product roadmaps and customer solutions.
Establish operating metrics, development processes, and resource plans that improve engineering efficiency, predictability, and product quality.
Build organizational capability by recruiting, developing, and retaining top engineering talent while creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, and innovation.
Represent engineering with customers, suppliers, and strategic partners to resolve complex technical and business challenges.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical discipline required; Master’s degree preferred. 12+ years of progressive engineering experience in complex capital equipment or related industry, including 5+ years in senior engineering leadership roles is also required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Demonstrated ownership of multiple concurrent product development programs from concept through release.
Experience managing budgets, resource allocation, and organizational planning responsibilities.
Proven success leading Mechanical, Electrical, Systems, and Software Engineering organizations in a product development environment.
Deep understanding of complex electro-mechanical systems and system-level engineering tradeoff decisions.
Skilled at translating customer requirements into product architectures, execution plans, and measurable business outcomes.
Experience balancing technical performance, schedule, cost, quality, and operational readiness across multiple programs.
Ability to influence senior stakeholders and align competing priorities across engineering, operations, commercial, and support functions.
Semiconductor equipment experience within deposition, etch, vacuum processing, thin-film technologies, ion beam systems, or related manufacturing platforms.
Skilled at communicating technical strategy, program risk, and business impact to executive audiences.

Salary And Benefits

The expected salary range for this position is $173,000-220,000, plus a bonus opportunity. We will consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors when determining your pay. If your salary requirements exceed the advertised range and you remain interested in Veeco, we encourage you to apply or email your resume to
recruiting@veeco.com .

Other Benefits Include

Medical, Dental, and Vision
401(k) with Company Match
Holiday, Vacation, and Sick Time
Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
Commuter Benefits
Life and Accident Insurance
Disability Insurance
Tuition Reimbursement
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Identity Theft Remediation
Emergency Travel Assistance

Veeco is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, and other legally protected characteristics. Veeco is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities.

jobs.description:
About Us

QISG leverages Quanta’s comprehensive resources to deliver collaborative solutions for our partners' energy infrastructure needs. We use in-house talent, expertise and resources to plan, design, engineer, manage, conduct maintenance on and construct projects.

Our turnkey service capabilities provide our customers with efficiency, consistency, attention to detail and safe execution. The QISG team brings together Engineering, Safety, Quality, Material Procurement, QA/QC, Right-of-Way Acquisition, Scheduling, Environmental Planning, Permitting, Title and Land Management expertise that ensure outstanding results for our clients.

About This Role

JOB TITLE:
Director, Engineering

The Director of Engineering for Substation is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing the planning, design, and implementation of Substation projects. This role involves managing a team of engineers and technical staff, ensuring that projects meet regulatory, safety, and quality standards, and supporting the company's strategic objectives. The Director will collaborate with other departments, stakeholders, and external partners to drive innovation, efficiency, and operational excellence in the company's transmission and substation engineering activities.

What You'll Do

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of engineers and technical professionals.
Establish and maintain a high-performance culture, with a focus on continuous improvement and innovation.
Foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that values diverse perspectives and talents.
Oversee the planning, design, and execution of transmission and substation projects, ensuring alignment with company goals and regulatory requirements.
Develop project budgets, schedules, and resource plans, and ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget.
Manage risks and resolve issues that may impact project scope, quality, and delivery.
Provide technical guidance and expertise in the design and optimization of transmission and substation systems.
Stay current with industry trends, technologies, and regulatory changes, and integrate best practices into the engineering processes.
Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and regulatory standards in all engineering activities.
Contribute to the development of the company's strategic plans and objectives, particularly in the areas of transmission and substation infrastructure.
Identify and evaluate new business opportunities, partnerships, and technologies that can enhance the company's competitive position.
Collaborate with other departments, such as Operations, Finance, and Regulatory Affairs, to align engineering initiatives with broader business goals.
Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including customers, regulators, contractors, and suppliers.
Represent the company at industry forums, conferences, and regulatory meetings, advocating for the company's interests and promoting its capabilities.

What You'll Bring

Minimum of 15 years’ experience in the electric utility industry performing engineering related duties and/or management for high voltage electrical projects.
Bachelor of Science degree (B.S.) or Graduate degree in Electrical Engineering from an ABET accredited university.
P.E. license required.
Proven track record of successfully leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and delivering complex projects on time and within budget.
Strong technical expertise in structural, civil, electrical, or mechanical engineering, with a comprehensive understanding of engineering principles and practices.
Expert knowledge of electric utility engineering and construction standards.
Advanced knowledge of utility industry processes including scheduling, contracts, coordinating and managing all disciplines.
Excellent business acumen and experience managing departmental budgets.
Knowledge of process and procedures for project controls and estimates.
Experience interpreting internal and external business issues, recommending best practices, mitigating risk and solving complex problems.
Demonstrated experience supporting external customers.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams, clients, and external partners.
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute strategic plans, drive innovation, and achieve business objectives.
Knowledge of relevant industry codes, standards, and regulations, including ANSI, ASTM, ACI, AISC, NEC, NESC, and others.
Able to deal with ambiguity and ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks and determine priorities in a complex environment.

At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

Architecture & Platform Strategy

Define and evolve the target-state architecture for the self-serve data, AI, and agentic AI platform, aligned to enterprise strategy, data mesh principles, and regulatory requirements
Establish enterprise standards and reference architectures for data products, semantic layer services, AI/LLM gateways, agent orchestration, and API- and MCP-based data access
Architect the platform layers that let AI systems and agents find, trust, ask, and act on enterprise data — including data product interfaces, semantic context services, and governed write/action patterns
Define tiered certification and governance patterns that scale data product trust from registered assets to autonomous-grade, AI-ready products
Establish foundational patterns for retrieval, context enrichment, grounding, and tool exposure (RAG, semantic layer, MCP tool surfaces) to support agentic and real-time decisioning use cases

Engineering & Infrastructure

Lead engineering of scalable, secure platform infrastructure on AWS (S3, Lake Formation, Glue, EKS, Bedrock, IAM, networking) and Databricks (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, Databricks SQL, MLflow, Mosaic AI)
Engineer the agentic AI platform stack: agent runtimes, orchestration, agent identity and access management, action/write contracts, evaluation harnesses, and observability
Implement platform engineering best practices: infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), CI/CD, automated testing, environment promotion, and GxP/Part 11-compliant change management
Drive operational excellence across reliability, cost management (FinOps for data and AI workloads), observability, and incident response, grounded in SRE and Well-Architected practices
Ensure security, data protection, and access governance patterns (fine-grained entitlements, row/column-level controls, audit lineage) meet regulated-industry requirements

Delivery Leadership & Product Management

Contribute to the platform product roadmap: define outcomes, prioritize the backlog, and sequence capability delivery against enterprise AI adoption goals
Lead delivery across a team of vendor partners, holding the team to clear standards for quality, velocity, and operability
Drive build/buy/adopt decisions with rigor — vendor evaluation, kill criteria, and total-cost analysis — and integrate acquired capabilities into a coherent platform experience
Define and track platform health and adoption metrics (DORA, reliability SLOs, self-serve adoption, time-to-data-product) and report progress to senior leadership
Serve as a trusted advisor and technical leader: mentor engineers, run architecture reviews, and partner with business domains to identify and enable high-value data and AI use cases
Communicate architecture and trade-offs crisply to audiences from engineers to Director/VP. stakeholders, simplifying complexity without losing rigor

Basic Qualifications

10+ years in platform engineering, data engineering, or enterprise data/AI platform architecture, including 3+ years leading engineering teams or major platform programs
Deep hands-on expertise with AWS data and AI services, including S3, Lake Formation, Glue, EKS, Bedrock, Kinesis/MSK, IAM, and Terraform-based infrastructure automation
Strong production experience with Databricks: Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, Databricks SQL, MLflow, and workspace/governance administration at enterprise scale
Demonstrated experience designing or building agentic AI or LLM-powered systems: agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, LLM gateways, tool/function calling, MCP or comparable protocols, and AI evaluation/observability
Proven ability to build resilient, scalable pipelines for high-volume batch and streaming data, with proficiency in SQL and Python (or Scala/Java)
Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architecture, workflow orchestration, and API-first integration patterns
Experience designing secure, governed, production-grade cloud architectures, including fine-grained access control, lineage, and auditability
Track record of delivery leadership: roadmap ownership, backlog management, cross-functional coordination, and shipping platform capabilities that achieve measured adoption
Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complexity and influence senior decision-makers

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in biopharma, life sciences, or other heavily regulated domains, with working knowledge of GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, and computer system validation
Background in data mesh or federated data architectures, data product operating models, and domain enablement at enterprise scale
Experience with semantic layer technologies, knowledge graphs, metadata/catalog platforms, and data contract frameworks
Familiarity with FinOps for data and AI workloads, including cost attribution, chargeback/showback, and LLM token economics
Experience managing large vendor/partner ecosystems and running structured vendor evaluations with defined success and kill criteria
Product management experience or certification; familiarity with DORA metrics, SPACE framework, and platform-as-a-product operating models
AWS Professional (Solutions Architect or Data Analytics) and/or Databricks certifications

jobs.description:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$139,400.00 - $230,000.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers is seeking a Director of Software Engineering to join our organization as we grow and transform our Technology landscape. Individual will complete advanced software end to end engineering tasks that span many parts of a system including designing, developing, analyzing, configuring, testing, debugging, troubleshooting, documenting, health monitoring/alerting, and implementing based on user or system specifications. Individual will also consult with users to determine hardware, software or system functional specifications, manage the effective use of resources, act as subject matter expert across multiple applications, systems and technologies, leverage technical and business knowledge to drive the planning and execution of complex initiatives, participate in the design/ development process, and provide technical leadership, while leading a team of SWE.

What Will You Do?

Lead a team of Software engineers by providing technical guidance and mentorship while modeling Travelers' leadership behaviors.
Direct complex design, development, analysis, configuration, testing, debugging, troubleshooting, documenting, health monitoring/alerting, and implementation based on user or system specifications for impactful and high-visibility tasks.
Lead investigation and resolution efforts for critical, high impact problems, defects, and incidents.
Seek opportunities where technology can be utilized to improve the business and provide more efficient processes.
Apply knowledge of current industry trends and techniques to formulate solutions for software engineering problems.
Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

5 years of related experience; including insurance / financial services industry experience.
Demonstrated experience implementing current technology trends and techniques (e.g., cloud-based solutions leveraging microservices).
Interprets internal/ external business challenges and recommends best practices to improve SDLC processes.
Delivery - Advanced delivery skills including the ability to determine the software design strategy and methodology to be used for efforts, use automated tests, analysis, and informed feedback loops to ensure the quality and production readiness of work before release, monitor the health of work efforts and that of adjacent systems.
Domain Expertise - Demonstrated track record of domain expertise including the ability to develop business partnerships and influence priorities by identifying solutions that are aligned with current business objective and closely follow industry trends relevant to domain, understanding how to apply them, and sharing knowledge with coworkers.
Problem Solving - Strong problem solver who utilizes data and proofs of concepts to find creative solutions to difficult problems, reflects on solutions, measuring their impact, and uses that information to ideate and optimize.
Also adept at making decisions that involve a significant number of factors with broad implications.
Communication - Strong communicator who possesses the ability to describe technology concepts in ways the business can understand, document initiatives in a concise and clear manner, collaborate effectively with teammates and others regardless of role, quickly extract core issues from discussions and meetings, give and receive constructive feedback, offer help when asked, and ensure everyone has a chance to share their thoughts and are heard; an attentive and empathetic listener.
Leadership - Advanced leadership skills with the ability to take action even when there is no clear owner, inspire and motivate others, and be effective at influencing team members.

What is a Must Have?

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience.
6 additional years of software engineering experience.

What Is in It for You?

Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.

.

Learn more at www.dashiell.com.

Primary Function

The Director of Engineering provides strategic leadership for Dashiell’s electrical substation engineering function, driving the technical direction, operational performance, and growth of the engineering discipline across all substation projects. This role holds full accountability for engineering quality, talent, and financial performance of the group. The position will be based in our Raleigh, NC office located at 11000 Regency Pkwy, Suite 107 Cary, NC 27518 and will report to Dashiell’s Vice President of Engineering.

Duties & Responsibilities

Employee may be called upon to perform any or all of the following functions:

Provide executive-level leadership for the Electrical/Substation engineering discipline, setting strategic direction and organizational goals for the Raleigh office and across all substation engineering groups.
Hold accountability for all substation engineering deliverables, technical quality, and client satisfaction across the portfolio, including physical design, protection and control, and relay engineering.
Lead development and implementation of substation engineering standards, design methodologies, QA/QC processes, and technology roadmaps for the Raleigh office.
Build and manage a high-performing substation engineering organization through talent acquisition, development, mentoring, and succession planning for the Raleigh office.
Serve as senior client executive for major utility, industrial, and renewable energy accounts, leading engineering pursuits and maintaining strategic relationships.
Collaborate with the Vice President of Engineering and executive leadership on business strategy, growth initiatives, and market positioning within the electrical infrastructure sector.
Manage the full engineering P&L for the Electrical/Substation function, including resource planning, budget management, project profitability, and financial forecasting.
Drive cross-functional coordination with construction, testing, project management, and business development teams to ensure seamless project delivery.
Oversee substation engineering proposals, scope development, fee estimation, and contract negotiations in support of business development.
Perform special projects and complete other duties as assigned or requested.

How You Will Make an Impact

Shape the future of Dashiell’s electrical substation engineering practice through strategic leadership, technical vision, and disciplined execution across the Raleigh office and beyond.
Drive revenue growth and market expansion in the electric utility, industrial, and renewable energy sectors through engineering excellence and strong client relationships.
Build an enduring, high-performing substation engineering organization that sustains Dashiell’s competitive advantage in the medium and high voltage electrical infrastructure market.

Required

Minimum Qualifications / Experience

Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university required; a power systems focus is strongly preferred. Master’s Degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 16 years of electrical substation engineering experience with at least 7 years in senior leadership and management roles.
Active Professional Engineer (PE) license required; ability to obtain licensure in multiple states required.
Extensive hands-on experience in high voltage substation engineering and design (138kV and above), including physical design, protection and control, relay engineering, and HV EPC project execution.
Proven executive engineering leadership with full P&L accountability for an engineering group or business unit.
Deep understanding of applicable engineering standards including NEC, NESC, IEEE, and ANSI as applied to substation design and construction.
Strategic thinking with the ability to set and execute organizational vision across multiple office locations and engineering disciplines.
Exceptional client relationship management and business development capabilities in the electric utility, industrial, and renewable energy markets.
Strong executive communication, influence, and team leadership skills.
Valid driver’s license required; must maintain an acceptable driving record throughout employment.

Physical Requirements

Physical Requirements

Ability to sit for extended periods during computer-based work.
Ability to stand and walk intermittently throughout the workday.
Occasional lifting of up to 20 pounds.
Occasional travel to other offices or meeting locations.

Occasional exposure to field or industrial environments during site visits.

The CTO, Software
organization at HP is a global team of thousands of engineers and leaders shaping the future of how software and platform technologies power HP’s product portfolio. The organization is responsible for the vision, strategy, architecture, engineering, and operations of the software and platform technology stacks behind HP’s products. These include modern, AI-native, end-to-end platforms spanning developer experience, data and AI, security, infrastructure, reliability and device software, as well as software stacks for customer-facing HP applications. Our mission is to deliver magical, AI-enabled experiences to tens of millions of customers worldwide. Beyond powering today’s products, the organization also helps define and shape HP’s next era of growth through technology innovation and active engagement across the software and AI ecosystems.

The Vice President, Technology & Architecture
role serves as a strategic thought partner to the CTO, Software at HP and is accountable for defining the technology direction, architecture, and innovation roadmap that drives engineering excellence and sustained business impact at HP. This role oversees software and platform architecture, technology incubation, technology strategy, and technology advocacy functions. This senior leadership position is critical to advancing HP’s software-led business transformation and growth by driving innovation and enabling new efficiencies and operating models.

This role reports to the Chief Technology Officer, Software at HP. This leader will serve as a trusted partner to C-level executives and stakeholders across product and technology, with the opportunity to deliver sustained, company-wide impact at HP—a global technology leader and long-standing Fortune 100 company with more than 28,000 patents, over $55 billion in annual revenue, and 58,000 employees worldwide.

Responsibilities

Lead by example, fostering a culture of accountability, technology and architecture excellence, and a customer-first mindset across the organization.
Attract, build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of talented technologists, architects, and engineers with diverse expertise, perspectives, and backgrounds.
Lead central architecture, with responsibility for developing the end-to-end, full-stack architecture across platform and product software engineering, including architecture principles, target architecture blueprints, and architecture evolution and migration plans.
Lead a team of senior distinguished engineers focused on next-generation technology stacks and architectures across software, data and AI, security, infrastructure, and reliability engineering.
Lead technology incubation, with responsibility for building and sustaining incubation environments that support CTO, Software; global business unit; and stakeholder technology innovation initiatives, and for delivering the HP CTO Lab—a new full-stack software and platform sandbox for conducting proofs of concept in partnership with CTO, Software teams, internal stakeholders, and external partners and customers.
Lead technology strategy, with responsibility for the roadmap of platform and software stacks, technology and vendor solution evaluation for strategic initiatives, and technology ecosystem monitoring and engagement.
Lead technology advocacy, including technology thought leadership, external industry engagement, internal thought leadership, hackathons, Developer Day, and related initiatives.

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field; a Ph.D. is preferred.
Current or prior experience operating at the VP level in technology or engineering within an established technology company.
15+ years of experience in technology, engineering, or related areas, including 8+ years leading organizations through senior leadership roles.
Proven success attracting top talent and building and leading high-performing teams that drive technology architecture, strategy, and innovation capabilities within large, complex product or engineering environments.
Experience driving technology innovation, strategy, and architecture within engineering organizations delivering capabilities for products used by millions of customers and/or large-scale commercial businesses generating more than $100 million in annual revenue.
Strong track record of improving operational efficiency and engineering effectiveness through strategic thinking and disciplined execution.
Experience leading or scaling functions such as technology architecture, innovation, and/or strategy.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and drive alignment across large, matrixed organizations with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical and operational topics clearly to executive audiences.
Strong collaboration and leadership presence, with a reputation for building trust, attracting top talent, and developing diverse, high-performing teams.

We are hiring a Senior
  Director of Member Experience Engineering
to lead this organization. You will own the engineering strategy and execution across three connected domains:
Member digital experience

— the member web portal and mobile apps, including care navigation, secure messaging, benefits and claims views, and the notification systems that keep members informed.
Member Advocate tooling

— the internal application suite our advocates use to serve members, plus the platforms that make advocates faster and more accurate.
Contact center experience (our biggest opportunity)

— the AI, automation, and platform work that reduces call volume, deflects and resolves inquiries earlier, and makes every advocate interaction better. This includes our Contact-Center-as-a-Service (CCaaS) platform, Agent Assist, virtual assistants, IVR automation, and conversational analytics.

— deflecting avoidable contacts, resolving inquiries in self-service, and giving advocates real-time, accurate answers when a human is the right channel.

for member experience engineering across web, mobile, advocate tooling, and the contact center — and translate it into a roadmap tied to measurable business outcomes (cost-to-serve, contact reduction, member and advocate satisfaction).
Lead the AI agenda for the contact center.

Drive the roadmap for Agent Assist , Smart Search, virtual assistants, IVR automation, and contact-deflection features. Push for real, defensible reductions in call demand and average handle time — not demos.
Own the call-center technology platform

, including our CCaaS migration and the integrations that connect telephony, chat, and digital channels into one member journey.
Own conversational and contact analytics

— topic tagging, quality monitoring at scale, and the reporting that tells us what members are calling about and which contacts we can prevent. Ensure this data actually steers the roadmap.
Deliver the member-facing digital experience

on web and mobile, meeting client and regulatory commitments (access controls, dependent access, SSO, privacy) on committed timelines.

— the internal applications that determine how efficiently and accurately advocates serve members.
Partner deeply

with our Customer Experience, Product and Design teams to build quality products for our members and member advocates

— hire, mentor, and develop engineering managers and senior engineers; set the bar for technical quality, security, and reliability in a HIPAA-regulated, PHI-handling environment.
Report up and out.

Communicate strategy, trade-offs, and results to executive leadership and represent engineering in cross-functional and client-facing forums.

in software engineering with 5+ years leading engineering teams
, including managing managers.
Proven ownership of large-scale, member- or customer-facing web and mobile products
.
Contact center / customer support technology experience

— hands-on familiarity with CCaaS platforms, telephony/IVR, agent-assist tooling, and support-operations metrics (contact volume, deflection rate, average handle time, first-contact resolution, cost-to-serve, quality/CSAT).
Applied AI/ML fluency

, especially using LLMs / GenAI to reduce support demand: knowledge of Retrieval-Augmentented Generation (RAG), intent detection, conversational analytics, and automated quality monitoring. and defending trade-offs to executives.
Excellent cross-functional leadership
across product, operations, design, data/insights, and external vendors.
Comfort operating in a regulated, data-sensitive domain
(healthcare/HIPAA a strong plus) where security and privacy are non-negotiable.

Healthcare, health-benefits, insurance, or other regulated-industry experience.
Experience running a vendor selection and migration
for a major contact-center or AI platform.
Background scaling both customer-facing product engineering
and internal operational tooling
in the same org.

Senior Director: Global Engineering - Decatur, IL

This is a full-time, exempt position.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Senior Director, Global Engineering to design, build, and lead a centralized, fit-for-purpose global engineering function that enables safe, reliable, and efficient capital project delivery across global operations. This role will serve as the enterprise engineering leader for capital projects, accountable for engineering strategy, technical governance, engineering standards, resource capability, and engineering deliverables across the project lifecycle.

The role will partner closely with Project Management, Project Controls, Procurement, Operations, and Business Leadership to support capital project delivery through a clearly defined FEL stage-gate. Depending on project size, complexity, and risk profile, this leader will establish the appropriate engineering delivery model, including self-perform engineering, internal shared services, external engineering partners, offshore delivery centers, and global capability centers.

Scope And Accountability

This role is accountable for the engineering function, engineering governance, technical standards, engineering resource strategy, and quality of engineering deliverables across the capital project portfolio. The role will provide engineering leadership across FEL, FEED, detailed design, procurement support, construction support, commissioning support, and technical handover.

The role will work in close partnership with project management and project controls functions, which retain accountability for integrated project execution, schedule, cost control, and overall project delivery governance

Setting Engineering Strategy:
Develop and implement engineering strategies, standards, policies, and processes that align with business objectives and improve project execution.

Engineering Lifecycle Leadership:
Provide engineering support and technical assurance across the full capital project lifecycle, including conceptual design, FEL, FEED, detailed engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and technical handover. Ensure deliverables are complete, risk-based, cost-effective, and aligned with project objectives.

Building Integrated Engineering Services
:Create and optimize end-to-end engineering and mechanical services by leveraging synergies between Engineering and ADM Mechanical to design, fabricate, and install static processing equipment across the Decatur complex.Managing and Developing Teams: Lead, mentor, and develop engineering personnel while fostering a high-performance culture focused on collaboration, continuous improvement, and succession planning.Ensuring Compliance and Safety: Maintain adherence to technical standards, safety requirements, environmental regulations, and industry best practices throughout project execution.

Overseeing Resources and Budgets: Self perform engineering projects, manage engineering budgets, workforce planning, vendor relationships, procurement support, and technical resource allocation to ensure efficient project delivery. Driving Stakeholder Alignment: Collaborate with operations, business leaders, clients, contractors, suppliers, and other stakeholders to align engineering initiatives with organizational goals.

Promoting Innovation and Engineering Excellence:Proactively identify and resolve engineering challenges, identify emerging technologies and industry trends, implement advanced engineering tools and methodologies, and drive improvements in efficiency, scalability, and project performance.

Qualification And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in engineering required; advanced degree (MS, MBA, or equivalent) preferred.
Licensed Professional Engineer, PMP preferred.
15+ years of progressive engineering, project execution, and capital project experience within manufacturing, industrial, energy, chemical, food processing, or related industries.
Minimum 5+ years of leadership experience directing global or multi-site engineering organizations, including responsibility for strategy, talent development, and organizational performance.
Demonstrated success building, leading, and developing high-performing, multidisciplinary engineering teams across multiple geographies.
Proven track record of delivering complex capital projects and portfolio programs utilizing Front-End Loading (FEL), Stage-Gate, and project governance methodologies.
Extensive experience managing engineering resources, budgets, CAPEX portfolios, and competing business priorities in a fast-paced global environment.
Proficiency with engineering and design platforms, including Autodesk, AutoCAD, Plant 3D, BIM, and other digital engineering and design collaboration tools.
Experience leveraging digital technologies, engineering data systems, and AI-enabled solutions to improve project execution, planning, forecasting, and operational performance.

Technical & Business Capabilities

Deep understanding of engineering governance, project controls, asset lifecycle management, risk management, and capital efficiency.
Experience implementing continuous improvement, value engineering, cost optimization, and productivity initiatives that drive measurable business results.
Ability to evaluate project economics, develop investment justifications, and ensure alignment with business and operational objectives.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to make data-driven decisions in complex and ambiguous environments.

Additional Requirements

Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.
Demonstrated success working in diverse, matrixed, and project-oriented global organizations.
Willingness and ability to travel internationally as required.

for a large, multi-location consumer organization modernizing its enterprise payment technology. This highly visible leadership role will build the payments function, guide a major processing transformation, and support high-volume transactions across physical locations and digital channels.

This opportunity is ideal for an experienced payments leader who enjoys developing teams, shaping strategy, and creating scalable solutions in a fast-moving environment.

Responsibilities

Build and lead a team of payment engineers, architects, analysts, and product owners
Define the enterprise payments technology strategy, architecture, and roadmap
Lead payment processor implementations, migrations, and modernization initiatives
Oversee payment gateways, APIs, transaction services, and third-party integrations
Support authorization, capture, settlement, refunds, chargebacks, and reconciliation
Direct POS, payment terminal, card-present, and digital payment capabilities
Ensure platforms are scalable, resilient, observable, and highly available
Establish PCI-DSS, tokenization, encryption, monitoring, and incident-response practices
Manage processors, acquiring banks, gateways, vendors, and implementation partners
Partner with Security, Finance, Compliance, Operations, and executive leadership

Approximately 10 years or more of enterprise payments, fintech, or payment-platform experience
Leadership experience involving payment technology teams or large transformation programs
Deep knowledge of processors, gateways, acquiring banks, card networks, and settlement
Experience supporting high-volume, omnichannel payment environments
Strong understanding of POS technology, digital payments, APIs, and cloud architecture
Expertise in PCI-DSS, payment security, tokenization, and encryption
Proven ability to build teams and establish effective operating processes
Comfortable balancing strategic leadership with detailed technical decision-making
Effective communicator who can influence technical, business, and executive stakeholders
